fact: 1939年9月3日11时15分（英国时间），张伯伦向全国广播宣布英国已对德宣战；11时20分伦敦首次响起空袭警报，后证实为误报；丘吉尔重返战时内阁任海军大臣。

sources.title: Diplomatic countdown to war (History of government / UK Government)
sources.quote: At Berlin time (11:15am UK time), Chamberlain addressed the nation and announced Britain’s declaration of war.

sources.title: Dunkirk 1940 timeline (dunkirk1940.org)
sources.quote: 11.00: Chamberlain addresses the nation to say that the ultimatum having expired, Britain is now at war with Germany. 1120: The first air raid sirens sound across London; this turned out to be a false alarm.

fact: 1939年9月1日（宣战前两天）英国启动「吹笛人行动」（Operation Pied Piper），三天内从城市目标区撤离约150万人，其中儿童约80万；撤离对象不仅有伦敦，还包括其他工业与港口城市。

sources.title: Child Evacuees in the Second World War: Operation Pied Piper at 80 (History of government / UK Government)
sources.quote: On 1 September 1939, the government had initiated Operation Pied Piper, which would see the evacuation of over 1.5 million people from urban 'target' areas, of whom 800,000 were children.

sources.title: How England Evacuated London's Children Ahead of World War II (HISTORY)
sources.quote: In all, Operation Pied Piper would see some 1.5 million people, including 800,000 children, evacuated from urban centers over the course of just three days.

fact: 1939年9月1日灯火管制（blackout）开始实施；9月23日汽油配给启动，9月27日宣布第一项战时税（所得税大幅上调）；战争头两周通过的紧急法案比一战头一年还多。

sources.title: Rationing in Britain during World War II (Faculty of History, University of Oxford)
sources.quote: The first commodity to be rationed in late 1939 was petrol, followed in January 1940 by the first foodstuffs: bacon, ham, butter, and sugar.

sources.title: Phoney War (World History Encyclopedia)
sources.quote: more emergency laws were passed in the first two weeks of the war than had been passed in the first year of the First World War

fact: 1939年9月宣战至1940年春西线无大规模陆战，史称「假战争」（Phoney War/Sitzkrieg）；英法依托马奇诺防线取守势，波兰独自承受德军主力。

sources.title: Phoney War (World History Encyclopedia)
sources.quote: The Phoney War was the period from the start of the Second World War (1939-45) when Britain and France declared war against Germany on 3 September until the start of significant military action in the West in the spring of 1940.

fact: 《1939年国民登记法》通过后，英国于1939年9月29日进行全国人口登记，动用6.5万名登记员分发约1200万户登记表；据此发身份卡，并在1940年1月配给制实施后凭登记发放配给簿，同时用于征兵与劳动力调配。

sources.title: 1939 Register (The National Archives, UK)
sources.quote: The 1939 Register was taken on 29 September 1939. The information was used to produce identity cards and, once rationing was introduced in January 1940, to issue ration books.

sources.title: Identity Cards in the UK (House of Commons Library LLN-2016-0002)
sources.quote: In 1939, identity cards were reintroduced as a security measure under the National Registration Act 1939. From 1939 to 1952 it was compulsory to carry an identity card in the United Kingdom.

fact: 英国配给从1939年末汽油开始，1940年1月扩展到培根、火腿、黄油、食糖；进口依赖品与动物来源食品随后跟进；配给簿凭1939年9月29日登记发放。

fact: 英国以战争储蓄券与国民储蓄运动筹资，1939年11月22日发行新的小额储蓄债券；战争开支从1939年的约15亿英镑升至1945年的60亿英镑以上。

sources.title: Committee on Small Savings (Bank of England, Archive 1939-1945 Ch.VII)
sources.quote: The issue was made on 22nd November 1939. The Committee also recommended in their Report a new small bond issue to attract money from people who had reached their maximum holdings in the other forms of investment

sources.title: What was life like on the British Home Front during WWII? (History Skills)
sources.quote: With an expenditure that rose from £1.5 billion in 1939 to over £6 billion by 1945, Britain needed to generate substantial revenue.

fact: 二战爆发时英国沿东海岸与南海岸已建成约21座「链家」（Chain Home）雷达站及数千英里专用电话线组成的地面网络，可在约200英里距离发现来袭机群；该系统在1940年不列颠之战中被证明具有决定性作用。

sources.title: The Battle of Britain: The (Not So) Few (The National WWII Museum)
sources.quote: Key to this integrated defense was the “Chain-Home” radar network built in 1939 that included some 21 towers ringing the British coastline.

sources.title: Chain Home Transmitter Tower, former RAF Stenigot (Historic England)
sources.quote: The site at Stenigot was selected in September 1937 to be one of the stations in the initial full chain of stations to protect the whole east of Britain. Work was started in 1938 and the station was functional in February 1939.

fact: 吹笛人行动把约150万城市居民（含80万儿童）在三天内安置到乡村与郊区家庭，形成对乡村寄宿、学校接待与物资调度的即时大规模需求；后续还包括海外（加拿大、澳大利亚等）私人与官方撤离安排。
